findings.summary: Several banks are marked 'מחיר אחר לצעירים' and 'לא בחישוב', so a 24-year-old can't tell whether another bank (for example לאומי) would be cheaper than the recommended פסגות.
The 'אינפלציה' toggle next to 'בכסף של היום' is unclear: the reader can't tell whether it is on or off, or whether to press it, and can't find the result in actual shekels.
The term 'הזוג' ('הזוג הבא בתור', 'בחרו את הזוג הזה') is unexplained. The reader only worked out later that it means an account and a fund together.
The cost comparison against the other pair ('18 ₪ יותר / 1,390 ₪ פחות / 342 ₪ יותר') is confusing: more tax is presented as good. The reader gave up on it.
The fund card's fee details ('0.1% קבועים, 0% משתנים, 0.025% נאמן') and terms like 'דמי משמרת' are jargon the reader didn't understand.
The waterfall section starts from a fund the reader never chose (הראל סל, ירושלים), which confused them. It repeats the same answer.
The fund-type tags ('קרן מחקה' / 'קרן סל' / 'מחזיקה את המניות' / 'כמה דרכים יחד') and the '(4A)'/'(40)' in fund names are unexplained.
'−0.04% בשנה · שנה אחת' in the fund list doesn't say what the minus is measured against.
The note 'יש ספק אם נמכרת שם: וואן זירו' contradicts וואן זירו being ranked number 3 in the account list, so the reader can't tell whether the fund can be bought there.
Stray developer-looking text '// הפס נחתך: הסכום ארוך מהשטח' appears on the page.
